candidats.titre: File:Saxon Herringbone flintwork Chancel 11 08 20 Photo A Rae.jpg
candidats.description: St Peter's Church, Forncett St Peter, Norfolk. A section of the external north wall of the Chancel, between two Perpendicular period windows. The flints are laid in alternating rows at different angles, typical of Anglo-Saxon work known as herringbone pattern. It indicates the Saxon date of the Chancel.
categories: St Peters Church, Forncett St Peter
